lane: independent source and lightweight infrastructure peer; no product build, browser, or release run

verdicts.A_source: accepted for the reported false-positive class and retained refusal behavior
verdicts.B_lightweight_infrastructure: accepted within the stated scope; product/runtime acceptance remains with the owner

evidence: Read the complete process classifier and admission, ownerless recovery, lease, and journal call sites independently of the repair report. The macOS ps comm column gates inspection to a live Node executable, so a zsh -lc command containing guard text cannot match. Node eval/print arguments return no runner match; a direct guard script operand matches; uncertain Node options containing the guard name return ambiguous-arguments and refuse.

Admission and ownerless recovery call the same legacyRunnerEvidence function. Admission still checks the canonical and configured legacy leases before scanning processes; the heavy-directory reservation, resource thresholds, and one-owner cap were not changed by this commit.

The scan compares the first process start with per-PID command output and rechecks PID/start immediately before recording a match. An exited or reused PID is skipped; a ps error other than an exited PID propagates and prevents admission.

The journal whitelist stores at most five matched PID/PPID/start/executable/reason records plus overflow. Its mapper strips command and environment even if supplied, and invalid evidence causes a journal failure rather than an unsafe completed decision.

UNGUARDED lightweight suite: node --test scripts/test-stabilization-resource-process.mjs scripts/test-stabilization-resource-lease.mjs scripts/test-stabilization-resource-journal.mjs; 19 passed, 0 failed. This includes a live macOS ps identity case and a copied-guard admission refusal carrying the real canonical lease.

Independent live macOS ps probe launched a Node guard-named script from a directory with spaces. The classifier returned ambiguous-arguments, which blocks admission, and the child exited before this review ended.
test_integrity: The copied-guard admission test replaces preflight with an immediate failure sentinel. If runner detection missed, the sentinel would produce a different error and no RESOURCE_LEGACY_RUNNER_BUSY journal event, so the asserted refusal cannot be supplied by the sentinel. The sentinel also prevents heavy work.
limits: macOS ps command is display text rather than a lossless argv vector. A path with spaces is conservatively refused as ambiguous instead of being attributed as a definite script operand.
PID/start comparisons have ps one-second start-time precision, so a pathological same-second PID reuse is outside this lightweight proof.
The probe verifies source and guard infrastructure only. It does not establish a product/browser verdict or explain historical refusals that lack PID evidence.
process_cleanup: The 19-test suite and independent space-path probe exited; no peer-owned probe process remains.
